statement: The preset verdict is LongMemEval-S only; no other suite or model family has a held-out v3 result.
Preference and abstention had no unused held-out ids, so both remain development-only with no held-out quality claim.
The answerer and the judge were the same model (mimo-v2.5), so judge leniency is unquantified.
Retrieval is lexical only and 11 of 30 multi-session questions have a needed round outside the top-32 candidates.
Temporal reasoning scored 12/20, the weakest scored ability.
About 78% of injected blocks were judged irrelevant (0.777); the read tools compensate.
The interaction of capacity limits with a growing exchange archive is unmeasured; no long-run or eviction campaign covered a filled store.
The completed paid lifecycle arm exposed foreign context in 13/24 sessions while labelled cross-project leakage stayed 0.
Fact extraction has no completed paid arm; the schema/repair fix is offline-proven only.
The lifecycle safety power target was not reached: only one persona completed both arms.
The om+fabric arm never completed (stopped after two questions), so the combined path has no completed paid evidence.
The exchange archive gates refuse real history: 2.271 refusals per 1,000 LongMemEval-S exchanges, touching 3 of 500 needed-session questions; adversarial detection was 33/34.
